inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration updates JSON documents with JSON_INSERT, using JSON_EXTRACT and nested IFNULL fallbacks so missing permission keys inherit an older aggregate permission while existing keys remain unchanged.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored policy-default migration. A single UPDATE adds missing edit and delete flags from an existing manage flag, falls back to false when no legacy flag exists, and preserves already-present values; ordered scalar projections verify the resulting booleans and NULL policy rows remain untouched. The source schema, permission names, literals, and migration context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Policy 401 inherits both missing flags from manage=true. Policy 402 retains its existing edit=false and receives delete=false because manage is absent. Policy 403 preserves an existing delete=true while adding edit=false from manage=false. Policy 404 has a NULL document and is excluded from the migration.
determinism_notes: Policy IDs, JSON documents, paths, fallback values, and final ordering are fixed; the migration uses no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE policy_defaults (policy_id INT PRIMARY KEY, policy JSON NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE policy_defaults SET policy = JSON_INSERT(policy, '$.edit', COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.edit'), JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.manage'), JSON_EXTRACT('false', '$')), '$.delete', COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.delete'), JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.manage'), JSON_EXTRACT('false', '$'))) WHERE policy IS NOT NULL AND (JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.edit') IS NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.delete') IS NULL)

SELECT policy_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.name')) AS policy_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.edit')) AS edit_flag, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.delete')) AS delete_flag FROM policy_defaults ORDER BY policy_id

checks.sql: SELECT policy_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.name')) AS policy_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.edit')) AS edit_flag, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(policy, '$.delete')) AS delete_flag FROM policy_defaults ORDER BY policy_id
